data.long_meaning: The name Hollyanne is a combination of Holly and Anne. Holly comes from the Old English holleigh meaning 'holly tree'. Anne is a variation of the Hebrew name Hannah which means 'grace'. This name could symbolize a bright and graceful woman. The name Hollyanne carries the meaning “Holly - bright, Anne - grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
